full_judgment: 3. Defendant No. 2 contends that he has purchased the land on payment of consideration in a bonafide manner. The defendant No. 2 has further alleged that the defendant No. I was not benamder of the plaintiff and the former purchased the property in 1957 out of his own funds given to him by his maternal grand-mother; the defendant No. 1 had separate business and he was not 3/4 of years then. The plaintiff and the defendant No. 2 had enmity with each other. He has further asserted that the defendant No. 1 had been possessing the suit land for more than 12 years and that the land has been recorded in the name of defendant No. 1 in M.R.R. khatian. The defendant after his purchase on 27.7.77 has been possessing the land.
